claims: Armando "Hormiga" González was born on April 20, 2003.
Armando "Hormiga" González is a Mexican professional footballer.
Armando "Hormiga" González is a centre-forward for Liga MX club Guadalajara (Chivas).
Armando "Hormiga" González broke club records for goals by a U-23 player in the 2025 Apertura.
Armando "Hormiga" González finished the Liga MX Apertura 2025 as a top scorer.
Armando "Hormiga" González scored 11-12 goals in the Liga MX Apertura 2025.
Armando "Hormiga" González received his first call-up to the Mexican national team in early 2026.
